annotations.title: Say what each bill does to a plan

description: For each bill, per plan: `net` (comes out of net pay before the split), `split` (is one share of the split, drawn on the bar) or `ignore` (this plan leaves it out). **A list in one call.** A bill the paycheck already took (a pension deduction) is outside the choice and refused. An expense with no choice made is ignored. This is the Plan screen’s switch on every row. **Dry-runs by default**: it shows each change and writes nothing until `commit: true`; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first. Ids come from `plans`.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true writes.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

roles.description: One entry per bill and plan. Up to 100 in a call.
